answer: The onyx edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 64 clones produces a signature the sparrow analysis flags immediately. An adversary must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, and hence doing work rather than printing keys, and the ocean settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
